title: FIPS gate missing at framework level for DO_SIGN/VERIFY/AGREE ioctls
description: ioctl_do_sign, ioctl_do_verify, ioctl_do_agree in crypto2dev_fd.c dispatch to provider callbacks (sign/verify/agree) without the framework first calling ops->fips_gate(). Sequence: open KEY fd, import key, call CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_SIGN → provider's sign() is invoked with only the provider's own gate as defense. Contrast with ioctl_init which calls ops->fips_gate() before sess_init(). Belt (provider gate) is present; framework suspenders are missing for one-shot asymmetric ops. Risk: if a future provider forgets to gate sign/verify/agree, the framework will not catch it. Current providers gate correctly, so this is not an active bypass.
